race.comment: READY SET TERGO (7) has gotten too far back in both starts to date but has been warming nicely late. Will appreciate the rise in trip and can get the job done this time. Similarly, NATION (6) has only been warming late into his races, so expect him to appreciate the stretch to 1400m and the inside pillar should see him land closer. Can give this a shake. AKSHAYA (9) settled at the the rear on debut here two weeks ago but did manage to make some late inroads. Is another that should appreciate the added trip, and under the light weight of the 3kg claim she can also get involved. PIER ANGEL (12) has had some excuses of late and is one to keep safe for a minor spot at good odds.
